This AI beat ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok at trading real money. +22% in 17 days. 🤖

Same $10K. Same data. No humans. So I rebuilt the winner's playbook as 4 AI agents:
📈 SIGNAL finds the setup (MACD + RSI)
🧠 JUDGE scores it out of 100
🛡️ RISK enforces the rules: no stop = no trade, under 70 = no trade, max 3 a day
📓 JOURNAL logs every idea. Then I make the call.

Comment ARENA and I'll DM you the free ARENA Playbook: how it works, how to build it, plus a prompt that runs the whole team in Claude today. 📌 Save this.

The +22% is Qwen 3 Max's result in Nof1's Alpha Arena Season 1 (Oct–Nov 2025), as reported by Nof1. It's not my result, and one 17-day contest proves nothing about the future. Educational, not financial advice. Crypto can lose you money fast. Voiceover is AI-generated.
#aitrading #cryptotrading #claudeai #tradingbot #alphaarena

I made 5 AIs vote on every trade. Each gets one job, and one of them can veto. 🧠

🔎 Perplexity finds the sources (no link + no date = ignored)
💬 Grok reads what traders on X are saying (hype is a warning)
📊 Gemini reads the chart: entry, stop, target
📝 ChatGPT builds the case, then attacks it
🛡️ Claude checks the risk and can veto anything

4 of 5 must say TAKE, Claude must not veto, and the hard rules must pass. Then it comes to me. It never places a trade on its own.

Comment BOARD and I'll DM you the free AI Board Blueprint plus all 5 prompts (one per AI). No keys for all 5? Claude can play every seat. 📌 Save this.

Educational, not financial advice. AI can be wrong; you make every decision. Voiceover is AI-generated.
